preconditions.description: The input n must be an integer.
The input n must be a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '' if n <= 0 else all(len(line) == i for i, line in enumerate(stdout.split('\n'), start=1))
postconditions.description: If n is 0 or negative, the output must be an empty string; otherwise, each line must have a length equal to its line number.
Each line must start with the string representation of n.

postconditions.expression: all(line == ''.join(str(i) for i in range(n, n - len(line), -1)) for line in stdout.split('\n'))
postconditions.description: Each line must contain the numbers from n down to the length of the line in descending order.
